name: Bracers of Archery

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Proficiency with Longbows and Shortbows, and +2 damage with them.
text: Wearing these bracers makes you proficient with both the Longbow and the Shortbow, and your damage rolls with either bow get a +2 bonus.
